event.dorian_heart2.1.text: A fox. By the fern. Don't move. She's listening too. Not to us.
event.dorian_heart2.1.why: frightened: the fox attends to something else; the player is not the thing being judged

event.dorian_heart2.1.text: A fox. By the fern. Don't move. She keeps facing the wood.
event.dorian_heart2.1.why: uneasy: animals face the wood (ladder), told as plain observation

event.dorian_heart2.4.text: There's another place. Further in. Not yet. Never after dark.
event.dorian_heart2.4.why: clue at full: the too-exact rule attached to the deeper place

event.dorian_heart2.4.text: There's another place. Further in. Not yet. Not on a new moon.
event.dorian_heart2.4.why: hint: an odd custom tied to the moon; a night the player can stay awake for

event.dorian_heart5.1.text: I've never shown anyone. Edmund found it. He wasn't looking for mushrooms.
event.dorian_heart5.1.why: clue: Edmund came here for another reason

event.dorian_heart5.3.text: He was counting the trees. Forty-one, then the way in. I know how far he got.
event.dorian_heart5.3.why: revelation: Dorian knew where Edmund went; hurt admission, echoes the thread without repeating it

event.dorian_heart5.3.text: He was counting the trees. I never asked. I think I knew.
He was counting the trees. I count them too. Habit.
event.dorian_heart5.3.why: uneasy: the Keeper tell is exactness

event.dorian_heart5.2.text: Keep it to yourself. The truffle is yours. Yours. Go home before dusk.
event.dorian_heart5.2.why: frightened: one repeated word (distortion) and too-exact care

event.reading_night.2.text: A snowdrop. Pressed. For the lamp. ...Sit near it. You look cold.
event.reading_night.2.why: frightened: Keeper turns gentle, and notices the player

event.reading_night.2.text: A snowdrop. Pressed. For the lamp. Keep it lit tonight. Late.
event.reading_night.2.why: uneasy: lamps lit early / care that is too exact

dlg.story.notes.dorian.0.text: A folded note sits half under the door. Dorian's hand is still on it. It shakes.
dlg.story.notes.dorian.0.why: frightened: the note writer is afraid too

event.story_notes_dorian.after.text: Three more doors. Before dark. Always before dark. Go home, [player].
Three more doors before dark. Not after. Don't follow.
event.story_notes_dorian.after.why: uneasy: the deadline is the tell

dlg.story.scarecrow.talk.1.text: Mine says nothing. It faces the wood. Crows won't go near it.
Mine says nothing. Crows hate that. There are fewer this fall anyway.

dlg.story.scarecrow.talk.r3.text: The crows. ...Barely came. Quiet fall. A tie, then. Take one.
dlg.story.scarecrow.talk.r3.why: uneasy: the crows did not show; choice still means a tie

dlg.story.pumpkin.dorian.2.text: ...Borrowed. The fog's been heavy. Mushrooms needed a roof. It was coming back.

event.story_pumpkin_dorian.after.text: Next fall I'll grow my own. ...You look tired. Pumpkins can wait.

dlg.dorian.notebook.0.text: Dorian takes a worn notebook from his coat. Its pages smell of warm earth.
Dorian takes a small, worn notebook from his coat. He glances at the trees first.

dlg.dorian.notebook.1.text: Mushrooms. Drawn. Hundreds. The last pages are the clearing. Not those.
dlg.dorian.notebook.1.why: revelation tier: the clearing is drawn, and withheld

dlg.dorian.notebook.1.text: Mushrooms. Drawn. Hundreds. Some pages are trees, numbered. Skip those.
dlg.dorian.notebook.1.why: clue: the count lives in the notebook

dlg.dorian.notebook.r1.text: One. Take the small brown one, under the fern. Keep it near you. Nights.
dlg.dorian.notebook.r1.why: frightened: gift becomes a keepsake against something

event.dorian_birthday.intro.text: ...My birthday. Marcus told people. Stay a minute. Not long. The wood's closer this year.
...It's my birthday. Marcus told people. Stay a minute. Not long. Leave before dusk.

dlg.dorian.birthday.c1.text: Offer a slow walk, near the path.
dlg.dorian.birthday.c1.why: frightened: same choice, the player stays close to the path

dlg.dorian.birthday.r1.text: Good. The moss is thick there. We'll stop at forty. Not further.
dlg.dorian.birthday.r1.why: clue: the count has an end he will not pass with the player

event.dorian_courtship.intro.text: ...I've been quiet a long time. One thing, then. I won't take it back. Will you court me? Slowly. Here. In daylight.

dlg.dorian.courtship.0.text: What do you say? ...Take your time. You're safe here.
dlg.dorian.courtship.0.why: frightened: gentler, and the reassurance unsettles

dlg.dorian.courtship.r0.text: ...Yes. I wasn't sure. I'll show you the quiet places. Nearly all of them.
dlg.dorian.courtship.r0.why: clue: one place he will not show

event.dorian_courtship2.intro.text: ...You said wait. I waited. The trees kept count. I'll ask once more. Will you court me? Slowly. Quietly.

event.dorian_partners.intro.text: I made something. Feather, stick, twine. The others would know it. It keeps you. Hold it.
event.dorian_partners.intro.why: clue: a Keeper's charm; protective, marks the player as kept

dlg.dorian.partners.0.text: Today's ours. Only today. I don't plan past days now.

dlg.dorian.partners.r1.text: The forest, then. Past the third tree. Not past the forty-first.

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_1.l4.text: ...You could have. You were counting. So was I.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_1.l4.why: hint: both lodgers count; overheard by the player

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_2.l4.text: Me too. Plane, please. We finish early tonight.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_2.l4.why: hint: Keepers leave early on certain nights

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_3.l2.text: Oak. Good. Heavy. Heavy is good, lately.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_3.l2.why: frightened: a door's weight matters now

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_3.l4.text: ...A very good door. Does it bolt? Some nights I'd want it to.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_3.l4.why: clue: he fears himself on certain nights; echoes Edmund's cellar door

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_4.l2.text: ...Toward the trees? Good. I can keep count from bed.

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_4.l4.text: The owl will want a name. It hasn't called lately. I'll wait.

event.overheard_dorian_hazel_1.l1.text: ...Hazel. Wood mud on your boots. Be careful.
event.overheard_dorian_hazel_1.l1.why: clue: the Keeper sees the resister's footsteps, and warns rather than threatens

event.overheard_dorian_hazel_1.l3.text: ...Quiet today. Even the jays. Third week now.

event.overheard_dorian_hazel_2.l3.text: ...They'd like that. Don't read my margins. They're only counts.
event.overheard_dorian_hazel_2.l3.why: hint: margins echo Edmund's almanac; Hazel will notice

event.overheard_dorian_hazel_3.l1.text: ...We could just sit. Not talk. Not about the almanac.
event.overheard_dorian_hazel_3.l1.why: clue: he knows what she has worked out

event.overheard_dorian_hazel_3.l3.text: The trees will join us. They're nearer already. Don't count them.
Then the trees can join us. They come a little closer each year.

adds.text: ...She's gone. Toward the wood. Stand close. Like a tree.
adds.why: replaces the cut 'she stayed' beat: the fox leaves the way everything leaves now; Dorian gets gentler

adds.text: ...You stand the way he did. Don't. Please.
adds.why: frightened: Dorian sees Edmund in the player and cannot bear it; protective, not sinister

adds.text: Most say good morning. A few say stay in tonight.
adds.why: hint: the anonymous notes double as warnings on certain nights; a curious player can go read them

cuts.why: the fox does not stay for a frightened player; the add after .1 fills the beat

notes: dlg.dorian.courtship.* keys are shared by dorian_courtship and dorian_courtship2; their variants (n0 frightened, r0 clue) apply in both scenes.
No variants for the {if}-markup '.after' lines (heart8, birthday, courtship, partners): a single variant would collapse the choice branches.
